review.why: Routes n8n work to task-specific skills and documents tool prerequisites and validation boundaries.
review.summary: Useful entry point to the official n8n pack. Very broad and tool-version dependent; it recommends multiple companion skills and includes cloud gateway defaults that must not imply permission to spend.
strengths: Explains real side effects of tests
cautions: Large always-on router adds context overhead
Gateway and telemetry defaults must respect owner preferences
